<a name="Schema"></a>Schema is the fixed schema value of a manifest and MaxSize is the maximum size in bytes.

```go
const (
    Schema  = "minisign-manifest/v1"
    MaxSize = 16 * 1024
)
```

<a name="Artifact"></a>
## type [Artifact](<https://github.com/brii26/release-signer/blob/main/pkg/manifest/manifest.go#L31-L35>)

Artifact describes the release file: its basename, size in bytes, and lowercase hex SHA\-256.

```go
type Artifact struct {
    Name   string
    Size   int64
    SHA256 string
}
```

<a name="Manifest"></a>
## type [Manifest](<https://github.com/brii26/release-signer/blob/main/pkg/manifest/manifest.go#L38-L45>)

Manifest is the release manifest \(Table 2.3\). Canonical gives the exact bytes that are signed.

```go
type Manifest struct {
    Schema    string
    Package   string
    Version   string
    Algorithm string
    KeyID     string
    Artifact  Artifact
}
```

<a name="ParseStrict"></a>
### func [ParseStrict](<https://github.com/brii26/release-signer/blob/main/pkg/manifest/manifest.go#L107>)

```go
func ParseStrict(raw []byte) (Manifest, error)
```

ParseStrict parses raw as a manifest. Besides strict JSON and field validation, raw must equal the canonical serialization byte for byte, so reformatted manifests are rejected.
